fact: In an interview published December 2025 the Director General of Taxes said télédéclaration covers all taxpayers and all taxes except a few spontaneous ones (registration duties, vignettes), and télépaiement by bank transfer is operational for all taxpayers of computerised centres, with mobile money and cards not yet available.
title: Hamadou Fall Dianka, directeur général des impôts dans l'essor : "Le télépaiement accélère la collecte des recettes fiscales"
